title: PORT-BRANCH-parked-claude-project-thread-uqzuai: carry parked/claude/project-thread-uqzuai onto main
body:
**Owner:** operations
**Trigger:** branch `parked/claude/project-thread-uqzuai` at cdcbb753f4 holds work main lacks and cannot merge as is (conflicts in code: .github/workflows/checks.yml, .github/workflows/retriage.yml, docs/BOOTSTRAP-GAPS.md, ip/provisional/drawings.pdf, ip/provisional/filing/FEES-AND-ENTITY.md, ip/provisional/filing/ads-data.json)
**Done check:** cmd:python3 -m foundation branchsweep --carried parked/claude/project-thread-uqzuai
**Status:** closed

Port the change by hand onto current main (it is 2 commit(s) ahead), keeping tests green; then the sweep deletes the branch.

size: M

**Closing probe:** python3 -m foundation branchsweep --carried parked/claude/project-thread-uqzuai

**Evidence:** Obsolete: the branch adds patent filing material (ip/provisional filing kit and preflight), which contradicts NO-PATENT-1 (no patent, hybrid USL-1.0 license); its retriage workflow and script are already on main (.github/workflows/retriage.yml, scripts/retriage.sh).
